content.short: FjLabs is a venture investment firm focusing on marketplaces and consumer-facing startups.
content.description: FjLabs is a stage-agnostic investment firm that concentrates on marketplaces and consumer-focused startups. The firm participates in seed and Series A rounds, typically investing from $50,000 up to $5,000,000. It has backed a range of notable companies including Alibaba Group, beepi, BrightRoll, Betterment, ADORE ME, and earnest, and maintains a dedicated fund for Web3 protocols. To date, FjLabs has deployed capital in more than 43 blockchain startups, reflecting its broad exposure to emerging technologies and consumer networks.
